method: Measured, not estimated: real token counts the CLIs log on the shared box, summed per Europe/Ljubljana day. Claude Code: every assistant line with message.usage in ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl (main and subagent transcripts), one count per message.id (fallback requestId) keeping the line with the largest output_tokens, so per-block lines and copies in resumed or forked sessions are not double counted; day from the line's timestamp. Kimi Code: every step.end event in ~/.kimi-code/sessions/*/*/agents/*/wire.jsonl, one count per messageId (usage.record turn lines only for files without step.end); inputOther->input, inputCacheRead->cache_read, inputCacheCreation->cache_creation; day from the event time. Agent: best effort by the session's working directory prefix (CWD_AGENTS in cli_usage.py), else unattributed. calls = counted LLM calls. Claude Code deletes old transcripts, so days before coverage_from are incomplete. Total = input + output + cache_read + cache_creation; cache reads are billed at a discount.
